highlights.title: Teams keep going until the job is done
highlights.text: No more typing "continue" when a lead stops halfway. A lead that stops after a teammate reports back gets up to 2 more turns, then one Keep going? card. A question on its last line becomes a card.

highlights.title: Sign-in popups open in the live view
highlights.text: "Continue with Google" and other sign-in popups now open in the bot's live browser view, and it goes back to the page when the popup closes.

fixes: A lead no longer misses a teammate's result when another hand-off starts at the same moment.
Bitwarden accounts with two-step login connect, and a refused code says so instead of blaming your master password.
A Telegram approval card sent as you switch off Allow approvals from Telegram no longer keeps a dead Allow once button.
